method.water: Planet green/NIR NDWI > 0.0; UDM2 clear pixels only
method.position: fixed Phase 11 transects, sampled at 3 m; sea-connected walk with 30 m of land; no interpolation across cloud gaps between 100 m landward of the edge and the sea end
method.confirmation: median of at least 2 valid monthly positions in each of the first and last radar quarters; optical shift >= 20 m in the significant radar trend's direction; pending when endpoint coverage is missing; withheld on radar-flagged tidal flats
method.tide: Planet mosaics are single-day acquisitions at unknown tide levels. Endpoint medians do not correct tides. Directional corroboration only, not validated shoreline accuracy or a Planet rate.
method.blindness: Phase 14 reference transects and their neighbours are excluded until unlocked
